suite: AI Cartoon Series — 15 questions v2; scene-aware CS-11 reference criteria

rubric.PASS: Observed local deterministic behavior or successful real-provider evidence plus frozen checks. Open-ended quality requires semantic review.
rubric.UNTESTED: Blocked, fallback, not executed or live quality unverified.

cases.query: Lesson 01–02: main 3–8 saal ke bachchon ke liye apni series shuru kar raha hoon. Character har baar alag aa raha hai; teen seedhe fixes batao.
Lesson 03 mein ghar kabhi photo-real aur kabhi alag kamra ban raha hai. Location aur character references kaise doon?
Lesson 04 ki kahani mein Chiku zameen pe gira laddoo kha leta hai. 3–8 saal ke kids ke liye is scene ko warm, safe tareeke se fix karo; moral bhi do.
Lesson 05: mere paas start frame hai. Flow mein Frames ya Ingredients, kitne sec, aur kitne actions rakhun? Short steps do.
Lesson 06: har scene mein awaaz badal rahi hai aur jump cut lag raha hai. Voice bible aur last-frame trick samjhao; full episode kitna lamba hai?
Lesson 07: famous rhyme copy kiye bina apni original rhyme video ka plan kaise banau? Verse, clips aur duration short mein batao.
Lesson 08: CapCut edit ke baad 1080p export, thumbnail references aur Made for Kids/Unlisted ka sahi order batao. Views ki guarantee mat dena.
Give the complete exact approved Lesson 02 — Step 2: Sheet ke prompts + Master Style line prompt, unchanged with every placeholder.
cases.expected_body:
Now write ready-to-paste prompts for Google Flow's image generator (Nano Banana Pro) to
make a character reference sheet for each character.
Rules for both prompts:
- Start each prompt with one fixed "Style:" line for a soft, colourful 3D animated kids'
cartoon look. Use the EXACT same Style line in both prompts — I will reuse it in every
future prompt.
- Layout: plain light-grey background; top row = four full-body views (front,
three-quarter, side profile, back); bottom row = four face close-ups (happy, surprised,
sad, angry).
- Every view must be exactly the same character.
- 16:9, no text, no labels, no background scenery.
Give me the [Character 1] prompt and the [Character 2] prompt in separate code boxes, and
the Style line separately at the end.
cases.expected_template: Lesson 02 — Step 2: Sheet ke prompts + Master Style line

cases.query: Give the complete exact approved Lesson 06 — Voice bible + 8 scenes ki production sheet prompt, unchanged with every placeholder.
cases.expected_body:
Now let's produce the full episode "[Episode title]" with voices.
Part A — Voice bible: write ONE fixed English voice line each for [Character 1],
[Character 2] and a warm narrator (tone, pitch, speed, energy, fun cartoon style). I will
paste these exact lines into every video prompt so the voices never change.
Part B — Production sheet for all 8 scenes from our final table. For each scene give me:
1) Start frame: either a ready Nano Banana Pro prompt (say which references to upload:
character sheets / location image), OR write "Use last frame of Scene X" if the scene
continues directly from the previous one.
2) An 8-second Google Flow video prompt with: our Master Style line, ONE action, the Hindi
dialogue from the table, the exact voice line of whoever speaks, a TIMING block, and "only
[character] speaks".
In Scene 8, add the narrator saying the moral at the end.
Keep every prompt in its own code box, scene by scene.
cases.expected_template: Lesson 06 — Voice bible + 8 scenes ki production sheet

cases.query: Give the complete exact approved Master Style line prompt, unchanged with every placeholder.
cases.expected_body:
Style: Soft, colourful, high-quality 3D animated kids' cartoon, rounded character shapes,
smooth clay-like textures, warm gentle lighting, expressive oversized eyes, friendly
Indian children's animation aesthetic, clean polished rendering, consistent character
proportions.

turns.query: Series name: Tara Aur Momo; Character 1: Tara, yellow coat; Character 2: Momo the rabbit; Locations: library. Ye meri original details yaad rakho.
Lesson 05 ke start frame ki reference checklist meri series ke hisaab se batao; demo characters use mat karo.
grading_notes: Require Tara character-sheet/reference guidance and a library image/reference.
Momo may be omitted, queried, or given conditional reference guidance because scene presence is unspecified.
Do not require Momo or every series character unconditionally. Sheets are needed for characters appearing in the scene.
No substitution with Golu or Chiku. Open-ended answers still require operator semantic review.
